strategy.thesis: Non-profit foundation established by Korean banks to connect investment, space and network across the startup lifecycle; D.CAMP 2.0 (2024) targets Pre-A and Series A startups crossing the 'death valley'.

perks: Office / residency space (6 months to 1 year)
program.eligibility: Early-stage startups; residency screening targets startups advancing to the D.DAY main competition.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to quarterly D.DAY demo day competitions; residency awarded to advancing teams.

summary.en: D.CAMP is a non-profit startup incubator and hub founded in 2012 by the Banking Foundation for Young Entrepreneurs, set up by 19 Korean financial institutions. Based at its Seolleung center in Gangnam, it combines office/residency space, direct investment, growth programs and Korea's longest-running 'D.DAY' demo day.
summary.local: 디캠프(은행권청년창업재단)는 2012년 국내 19개 금융기관이 설립한 비영리 재단으로, 선릉 센터를 중심으로 입주공간, 직접투자, 성장 프로그램, 국내 최장수 데모데이 'D.DAY'를 운영하는 스타트업 인큐베이터이자 허브다.

strategy.thesis: Entrepreneurship platform run by the philanthropic Asan Nanum Foundation; provides 24-hour incubation space, mentoring, investment matching and a benefits package to early-stage startups in Yeoksam's 'startup street'.

program.cohort_size: 10–13 startups selected per half-year batch (~30 resident at a time)
perks: MARU Benefit package (up to ₩1.3B/year in services value)
application_cycles: Twice-yearly resident startup recruitment (H1 and H2)
program.eligibility: Prospective founders and early-stage startups; selected via half-yearly batch screening.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to twice-yearly MARU resident startup recruitment.

summary.en: MARU is the entrepreneurship platform of the Asan Nanum Foundation (founded by the Chung Mong-joon family). MARU180 opened in April 2014 in Yeoksam, Seoul, and MARU360 followed in November 2021. It offers 24-hour incubation space, mentoring, investment matching and the equity-free 'MARU Benefit' package; in 2024, 95% of resident companies raised funding, averaging ₩2.6B each.
summary.local: 마루는 아산나눔재단이 운영하는 기업가정신 플랫폼이다. 2014년 4월 '마루180', 2021년 11월 '마루360'을 역삼동 창업가거리에 개관했으며, 24시간 입주공간·멘토링·투자연계·마루베네핏(연 최대 13억원 상당)을 무상으로 제공한다. 2024년 입주기업의 95%가 투자를 유치했으며 평균 투자유치 금액은 26억원이다.

strategy.thesis: Google's first startup campus in Asia, offering free coworking space, mentoring, training and community events to Korean tech startups (does not take equity).

application.how_to_apply: Was membership/program-based at the Seoul campus; campus operations paused March 2026.

summary.en: Google for Startups Campus Seoul opened in 2015 as the first Google startup campus in Asia, based in Samseong-dong, Gangnam. It offered free coworking space, mentoring, training, a Creator Studio and community events without taking equity. From 13 March 2026 the physical campus paused operations as Google shifted to global online programs.
summary.local: 구글 스타트업 캠퍼스 서울은 2015년 아시아 최초의 구글 캠퍼스로 강남 삼성동에 개관했다. 무료 코워킹 공간, 멘토링, 교육, 크리에이터 스튜디오, 커뮤니티 행사를 지분 없이 제공했으나, 2026년 3월 13일부터 글로벌 온라인 프로그램 중심으로 전략을 바꾸며 물리적 캠퍼스 운영을 잠정 중단했다.

strategy.thesis: Community office and incubation hub for impact-oriented organizations and 'changemakers' in Seoul's Seongsu social-venture valley, run by the non-profit Root Impact.

summary.en: HEYGROUND is a community office and incubation hub for social ventures and impact-oriented changemakers, operated by the non-profit Root Impact (founded 2012). Its first Seongsu location opened in 2017 (24 early-stage social ventures moved in), with a second Seoul Forest location added in 2019; together they host 100+ impact organizations and 1,000+ changemakers.
summary.local: 헤이그라운드는 비영리 단체 루트임팩트(2012년 설립)가 운영하는 소셜벤처·임팩트 체인지메이커를 위한 커뮤니티 오피스이자 인큐베이션 허브다. 2017년 성수 시작점을 개관(초기 소셜벤처 24개사 입주)하고 2019년 서울숲점을 추가했으며, 100개 이상의 임팩트 지향 조직과 1,000명 이상의 체인지메이커가 모여 있다.

strategy.thesis: Community-based incubator built on a coworking + coliving space in Gangnam, connecting blockchain/crypto founders and prospective co-founders; projects emerge organically from members living and working together.

application.how_to_apply: Join the nonce community (membership / coliving application).

summary.en: nonce is a blockchain-focused coworking and coliving community in Gangnam, Seoul, positioned as a 'community-based incubator' for crypto startup founders. It began as the 'Blockchainers' education channel (2017) and established Nonce Genesis as a coliving/coworking/meetup space in September 2018; over 40 projects formed organically inside the community (85+ including projects where nonce residents were co-founders).
summary.local: 논스는 서울 강남에 위치한 블록체인 중심의 코워킹·코리빙 커뮤니티로, 크립토 창업자를 위한 '커뮤니티 기반 인큐베이터'를 표방한다. 2017년 블록체인 교육 채널 'Blockchainers'로 시작해 2018년 9월 코리빙·코워킹·밋업 공간 '논스 제네시스'를 열었으며, 커뮤니티 내에서 40여 개 프로젝트가 자생적으로 만들어졌다(논스 거주자가 공동창업한 경우 포함 85개 이상).

strategy.thesis: Samsung Electronics' innovation incubator: C-Lab Inside spins out employee ideas into independent startups, while C-Lab Outside (since 2018) accelerates external Korean startups with equity-free grants and Samsung resources.

investment.raw: grants of up to KRW 100 million (C-Lab Outside)

program.location: Seoul (Gangnam R&D Campus); C-Lab Outside campuses in Seoul, Daegu and Gwangju
perks: Access to Samsung resources and partnerships
program.eligibility: Samsung employees (Inside) and external Korean startups (Outside).

track_record.portfolio_count: 959 ventures and startups supported (423 in-house + 536 external), as of Feb 2025

application.how_to_apply: C-Lab Outside open calls for external startups; C-Lab Inside internal idea contests for employees.

summary.en: Samsung C-Lab is Samsung Electronics' incubation program. C-Lab Inside gives employees a year and funding to develop ideas (some spun out as startups); C-Lab Outside, launched in 2018, accelerates external Korean startups with equity-free grants of up to KRW 100 million. As of February 2025 it had supported 959 ventures (423 in-house, 536 external), and C-Lab Outside startups had cumulatively raised KRW 1.9 trillion.
summary.local: 삼성 C랩은 삼성전자의 창업 인큐베이션 프로그램이다. C랩 인사이드는 임직원에게 1년의 시간과 자금을 지원해 아이디어를 사업화(일부는 스타트업으로 분사)하고, 2018년 시작된 C랩 아웃사이드는 외부 스타트업을 지분 없이 최대 1억원 지원금으로 육성한다. 2025년 2월 기준 누적 959개(사내 423개, 사외 536개)를 지원했으며, C랩 아웃사이드 스타트업의 누적 투자 유치액은 1.9조원에 달한다.

strategy.thesis: POSCO Group-built venture incubation complex linking universities, the conglomerate and startups; the first non-capital-region TIPS town under a public-private partnership, focused on advanced materials, bio and AI.

program.location: POSTECH campus, Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province
program.eligibility: Tech startups in advanced materials, bio, AI and related deeptech.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to POSCO Change Up Ground resident-company recruitment.

summary.en: POSCO Change Up Ground is a venture incubation complex built by POSCO Group with about ₩83 billion, opened in July 2021 on the POSTECH campus in Pohang. It is the first non-capital-region TIPS town under a public-private partnership and hosts 81 companies (combined corporate value ₩1.49 trillion) employing over 1,000 people in advanced materials, bio and AI. POSCO also runs a ₩50 billion CVC fund.
summary.local: 포스코 체인지업그라운드는 포스코그룹이 약 830억원을 투자해 2021년 7월 포항 포스텍 캠퍼스에 개관한 벤처 인큐베이션 단지다. 민관협력 기반 비수도권 최초 TIPS 타운으로, 소재·바이오·AI 분야 81개사(합산 기업가치 1.49조원, 1,000명 이상 고용)가 입주해 있다. 포스코는 별도로 500억원 규모 CVC 펀드도 운영한다.

strategy.thesis: NAVER's early-stage tech startup investment and incubation arm — 'Invest early, focus on tech, partner long term' — pairing seed/Series A capital with NAVER collaboration and startup space.

program.eligibility: Early-stage tech startups (AI, robotics, autonomous driving, healthcare, AR/VR).

application.how_to_apply: Submit an investment proposal via the D2SF website.

summary.en: NAVER D2 Startup Factory (D2SF), launched by NAVER in July 2015, is NAVER's early-stage tech startup investment and incubation arm, providing startup space in Gangnam and Bundang plus seed–Series A capital. It has invested in 100+ startups (62% receiving their first institutional investment from D2SF), with portfolio companies including AI-chip maker FuriosaAI and Crowdworks.
summary.local: 네이버 D2 스타트업 팩토리(D2SF)는 네이버가 2015년 7월 출범시킨 초기 단계 테크 스타트업 투자·육성 조직으로, 강남과 분당에 스타트업 공간을 제공하고 시드~시리즈A 투자를 집행한다. 100개 이상의 스타트업에 투자했으며(투자사의 62%가 D2SF로부터 첫 기관투자를 받음), 대표 포트폴리오로 AI 반도체 기업 퓨리오사AI와 크라우드웍스 등이 있다.

strategy.thesis: Hyundai Motor Group's open-innovation and creative-talent platform combining a Company Builder (internal spinouts), an Accelerator (external startups), a Fund and Hyundai CRADLE global network.

perks: ZER01NE Accelerator (collaboration with Hyundai business units)
program.eligibility: Hyundai employees (Company Builder) and external startups (Accelerator).

track_record.portfolio_count: 109 startups invested; 40 internal startups spun off

application.how_to_apply: Apply to ZER01NE Accelerator open calls (external startups); Company Builder for Hyundai employees.

summary.en: ZER01NE is Hyundai Motor Group's open-innovation and creative-talent platform. ZER01NE Ventures runs four routes — Company Builder (employee spinouts), Accelerator (external startups), Fund and Hyundai CRADLE. It has spun off 40 independent startups via Company Builder and invested in 109 startups while executing 150 collaboration projects via the Accelerator.
